Question: Dear sir i will like you to make this clear to me as i dont understand,i was praying magrib in on of these mosqe and when the imam reach to this verse in the quan(muhammadu rasulu lahi)all the mamomeen says(salalahu alihi wasalam)they say it loudly i will like to know if it is in teachings of the messenger. ////Wasalam Answer ID: 4404 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 643/601=L/1429) The Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) did not teach it; even it will nullify the salah : سمع اسم اللہ تعالی فقال: جل جلالہ او النبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم فصلی علیہ او قرآۃ الامام فقال: صدق اللہ ورسولہ تفسد ان قصد جوابہ ( الدر المختار مع الشامی: 2/380 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
